test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Murder of an infant
solution:
The correct answer is 'Infanticide'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Infanticide**'.
 
• It means '**the crime of killing a child within a year of birth**'. 
 
 
• ​*Example: Some societies still perform **Infanticide** due to belief derived from biological cause.*
 
 
 
• The term "infant" refers to a very young child, typically one who is under the age of one year old. 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

Correct Answer:__ Infanticide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• We should learn the words in a bunch if we want to enhance our vocabulary skills, learning through root words serves that very purpose.
 
• There are some other words with the** suffix '-cide'** given below:
 
• **Foeticide **- practice of aborting a foetus.
 
• **Feticide** - destruction or abortion of a fetus.
 
• **Sacrifice**- practice of self killing for a social cause.
 
• **Regicide**- the killing of the king.
 
• **Sororicide**- the killing of the sister.
 
• **Parricide**- the killing of the parents.
 
• **Matricide**- the killing of the mother.
 
• **Homicide**- the killing of a person; murder
